Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section keeps the desk steady, the handoffs calm, and the traveler experience clear when animals move with Aurelia Skyways.

The desk staff set the tone from the first contact. We explain the needed travel steps in plain language, check the booking details, and make sure every document is in place before the trip reaches the gate flow. If the traveler has a pet with special handling needs, we note those details early and pass them on without drama so the rest of the team can prepare properly.

When a carrier comes through the operation, the ground team moves it carefully between services and keeps it upright, secure, and visible to the right staff. The desk stays in sync with loading, transfer, and arrival teams so no one is left guessing. If something looks unclear, we pause the handoff, review the file, and keep the traveler informed in a calm way that avoids mixed messages.

Escalations follow a stepwise review. The first check is always the most practical one, then the desk brings in the next support level only when needed. We do not rush a decision, and we do not speculate about outcomes. The aim is to protect the animal, support the traveler, and keep the airline process clean from start to finish. Rosie or any other pet should be handled with the same steady care, whether the journey is simple or needs extra attention.

Graceful service at this desk depends on good notes, clear handovers, and a calm voice. Please contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor if a case needs immediate review or if the next step is not obvious.
